description: This file declares utility classes and structures for converting ANGLE graphics formats to Metal API formats, including pixel and vertex formats, and manages format tables for Metal rendering.

classes.name: FormatBase
classes.description: Base structure for format conversion utilities, holding format IDs and comparison operators.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents a pixel format with methods to validate and retrieve internal formats.

classes.name: VertexFormat
classes.description: Represents a vertex format with Metal-specific format and load function.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Manages tables of pixel and vertex formats for Metal rendering, including initialization and retrieval functions.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two FormatBase objects based on format IDs.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two FormatBase objects.

methods.name: actualAngleFormat
methods.description: Returns the actual ANGLE format associated with the FormatBase.

methods.name: intendedAngleFormat
methods.description: Returns the intended ANGLE format associated with the FormatBase.

methods.name: intendedInternalFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the intended internal format for the Format.

methods.name: FormatRenderable
methods.description: Determines if a given MTLPixelFormat is renderable.

methods.name: FormatCPUReadable
methods.description: Determines if a given MTLPixelFormat is CPU-readable.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the FormatTable with display-specific format data.

methods.name: generateTextureCaps
methods.description: Generates texture capabilities and compressed formats for a display.

methods.name: getPixelFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the pixel format corresponding to an ANGLE format ID.

methods.name: getVertexFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the vertex format for a given ANGLE format ID, considering packing.
